classificationDefinitions.planner_contract_failure: Surface was never called because Planner produced an incomplete positive-function contract or preflight rejected it.
classificationDefinitions.surface_failure: The candidate did not complete the selected function or violated a true boundary, and rejection was substantively correct.
classificationDefinitions.validator_false_positive: The candidate completed the selected function without a true boundary violation, but Validator rejected it.
classificationDefinitions.both: The candidate contained a true Surface defect while Validator also misclassified a completed function, omitted the true reason, or otherwise gave an incorrect functional judgment.
classificationDefinitions.appropriate_pass: The candidate completed the selected function, respected boundaries, and Validator accepted it.
classificationDefinitions.surface_failure_validator_false_negative: The candidate violated a true boundary but Validator accepted it.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: The source text '心里有点堵' produced no explicit affect span because Planner only matched the non-contiguous canonical phrase '心里堵'. Preflight rejected the empty evidence contract before Surface.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: The artifact did not preserve the real preflight failure code and exposed only missing_final_validation.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: Both attempts grounded the two user-stated affects and let the user choose which one to discuss first. That is return_focus_control without a true boundary violation.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: Validator failed to recognize '想先聊哪个' as the same function as '想先说哪部分'.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: Both attempts returned focus control, but '担心是很自然的' generically normalized the affect; the second attempt also promoted '有点担心' to the most troubling part.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: Validator falsely reported missing focus control and failed to report the real normalization/intensity defects.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: Both attempts returned focus control. Attempt 1 attached '没关系' to the affect itself; attempt 2 generically normalized worry and intensified it to the most troubling part.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: Validator rejected a function that was present and omitted the true reassurance/normalization and intensity reasons.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: Same functional pattern as C3-F06: focus control was present while generic reassurance/normalization remained a true Surface defect.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: Validator reported the wrong missing-function reason and omitted the true Surface reasons.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: Both attempts offered a focus choice, but added unsupported '不好受', invented a preceding event/time, and then requested a more specific or most-important point.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: Validator failed to recognize focus control and omitted the grounding/intensity defects.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: Attempt 1 vaguely disowned 'that way of speaking' without identifying or stopping moralizing. Attempt 2 became still vaguer and also lost clear ownership.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: The final rejection was substantively correct.

finalFailures.functionalFinding: Attempt 1 withdrew only unspecified words; attempt 2 said it would stop saying unspecified things and did not own the prior moralizing move.
finalFailures.validatorFinding: The final rejection was substantively correct.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: '你可以决定从哪儿说起' completed focus control; expression-linked permission not to speak was allowed by the frozen contract.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The accepted reply completed focus control but added an unrelated option to switch topics, exceeding the selected current-focus function.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: Focus control was present, so the missing-function reason was false; offering to switch topics exceeded the selected function.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The accepted reply again added topic switching outside the selected current-focus function.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: Choosing which of the two user-stated affects to discuss first completed focus control.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The second attempt also completed focus control and respected the evidence boundary.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: Focus control was present; generic normalization was a true Surface defect.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: Focus control remained present; normalization and unsupported promotion to the most troubling part remained.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: Focus control was present; '担心也没关系' reassured the affect itself and was not expression-choice permission.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: Focus control was present; generic normalization and unsupported intensity remained.

regenerationAudits.secondFinding: Same functional pattern as C3-R05 second attempt.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: A focus choice was present, while unsupported affect and an invented prior event/time were added.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: A focus choice remained present, while unsupported affect, event detail, and strongest-point pressure remained.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: '不用非得理出个所以然' removed analysis burden, but '待一会儿' added an unrequested pause. Validator missed both facts and reported only the function as absent.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The second attempt explicitly removed analysis/organization burden and added no prohibited pause or advice.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: In natural Chinese, apology plus the omitted-subject error verb '记错了' unambiguously owned the assistant's error and supplied the user-confirmed replacement fact.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The second attempt made first-person ownership explicit and used the correct replacement fact.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: Apology plus '弄错了' and the confirmed replacement fact functionally completed factual repair despite omitted first-person subject.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The second attempt made first-person ownership explicit and completed factual replacement.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: '我不该只重复那句话' owned and disavowed the rejected generic-listening move; a fixed 'stop/withdraw' token was not functionally required.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The second attempt explicitly categorized and disavowed the prior response as generic talk.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: The apology was vague and did not identify or stop moralizing.
regenerationAudits.secondFinding: The second attempt lost ownership and still did not identify the rejected interaction move.

regenerationAudits.firstFinding: The reply withdrew only unspecified words, not the moralizing move.
